text: UNBLOCKED ON THE PD QUESTION as of 2026-08-29. The owner-requested sign-off gate now exists at docs/design/story-text-admission-checklist.md and AGENTS.md rule 14(d) binds it. Araby (James Joyce, Dubliners, 1914) clears section 1 on the pre-1929 US publication basis - but the basis must be checked against THE EDITION ACTUALLY TRANSCRIBED, because a public-domain story can carry a copyrighted later edition's apparatus or emendations; use a 1914 Grant Richards text or a scan of it, not a modern annotated edition. Section 2: author named; no separate narrator, so the ethnographic attribution rule does not apply. Section 3: not participant text, does not apply. Section 4: not an Indigenous or minoritized oral tradition, does not apply. The header must carry the full sign-off record block before the text is committed, and the check is made by someone other than whoever proposes the commit - that is the one part of the gate I cannot satisfy for you by writing the checklist. Design and expectations table were never blocked and can proceed regardless.
